scope: Development-only supervised feasibility pilot authorized by the user. Not the confirmatory four-arm experiment or general multi-target benchmark.
data_attribution: Phillips et al., eLife 2021, doi:10.7554/eLife.71393, Figure 1 source data 1 v3; CC BY 4.0; https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC8476123/
target: Assayed H1 ectodomain; 5CJQ is declared different-construct structural context, not an exact assay construct.
eligibility: At least two finite H1 replicates; every observed replicate strictly above the 7.0 censoring floor. Mean and sample SEM recomputed from raw replicates; no SEM-based weights.
split: Seeded sequence-only choice of four loci; seeded permutation of their 16 bit patterns into 10 training, 3 development, 3 reserved test blocks. Not distance-separated. Test labels are excluded before aggregation, fitting, threshold selection, and evaluation.
objective: Uniform sampling with replacement from training genotypes at or above the training-only 75th percentile of recomputed H1 means; minimize mean negative constrained log q over 16 sites. Native decoder trainable, encoder frozen; dropout off, temperature 1.
evaluation: Deterministically selected development candidates, chosen by genotype hash without labels. Report parent/final log q and rank correlation against measured means. Additive ridge baseline fit on eligible training data only. No final-test evaluation, checkpoint selection, DPO, or biological improvement claim.
